messages:
marta: FYI: small runtime maintenance tonight 23:15 UTC in eu-west. Scope: kernel micro-patch + quantization profile tweak + temporary pin to redwood-v2-small. Target customer window ~23:15-00:00 UTC.

deploybot: Deploy scheduled: runtime-eu-kernel-2026-03-21. Canary: 6 containers (5% traffic). Plan: canary -> 30% -> 70% -> 100%. Auto-rollback triggers: 2m sustained 5xx > 0.8% OR p99 > baseline*1.6.

lee: Can we get a one-line statuspage blurb to schedule?

marta: Draft: "Planned maintenance: brief runtime update in EU (kernel + model pin). Date: 2026-03-21 23:15 UTC. Minor, transient retries possible during canary. Details: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2864301234"

sara: Add fallback line: "If issues occur, traffic will automatically fall back to redwood-v2-small-fallback."

ops_sre: Preflight checklist: healthcheck curl -> 200, run synthetic long-prompt smoke, snapshot KV cache, monitor p50/p99 and 5xx. Rollback if 5xx >0.8% for 2m OR p99 >= baseline*1.6.

emily: Customer email snippet:

emily: Subject: Planned maintenance  EU runtime  Mar 21 23:15 UTC

emily: Body: "We will apply a brief runtime update in EU on Mar 21 at 23:15 UTC. Most customers will be unaffected; a small fraction may see short retries during canary. The model redwood-v2-small will be pinned during the change. Live updates: https://status.redwood.ai/"

marta: Support FAQ quick-answer: "Why pinned?" -> "Temporary pin ensures consistent behavior during kernel changes; pin removed if no issues."

support-bot: Reminder: schedule status update at 2026-03-21T22:55:00Z (20m prior).

ops_sre: Canary started. Monitoring now.

deploybot: Canary update (4m): 5xx 0.2%, p99 +9%. No rollback. Proceeding to 30% in 3m.

lee: Noting a rare decode error sample from one canary request (tokenization anomaly). Ops investigating.

ops_sre: Investigating sample; looks like a bad edge-case prompt. No pattern yet. Excluding that container from next tranche.

marta: Good call. Exclude and continue. No customer notice unless error rate increases.

deploybot: 30% complete. Metrics stable.

emily: Statuspage posted and email queued to low-priority recipients (23:00 UTC send).

marta: Proceed to 70% after 10m hold.

deploybot: 70% complete. 5xx steady at 0.11%, p99 +11%.

ops_sre: All windows look clean. Proceeding to 100%.

deploybot: 100% rollout finished at 00:02 UTC. No rollback triggered.

marta: Final status update: maintenance completed; no widespread customer impact. Closing thread.

support-bot: Incident resolved: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2864301234  resolved 2026-03-21T00:05:00Z
